title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_detalles_que_enamoran_by_david_gomez_1plm1 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_detalles_que_enamoran_by_david_gomez_1plm1' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Full control may be given to an outside entity, risking exposure of all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different computer is strongly advised.
